episodes.title: The Call
episodes.summary: While working the night action desk, FBI agent Peter receives a distress call and is soon put in charge of protecting cybersecurity expert Rose.

episodes.title: Redial
episodes.summary: After looking for a link between the Campbells and the FBI, Peter is forced to go on the run with Rose in search of a hard drive — and more answers.

episodes.title: The Zookeeper
episodes.summary: Peter teams up with Rose for a risky mission at the White House. Elsewhere, a notable agent joins the security detail for the vice president's daughter.

episodes.title: Eyes Only
episodes.summary: Rose and Peter seek out one of the Campbells' recent contacts and uncover new intel. Monks opens up to Chelsea. Paulo makes a move on Maddie.

episodes.title: The Marionette
episodes.summary: Peter visits someone close to Hawkins. Rose makes a key connection. Maddie's night out takes a dangerous turn, spurring the Secret Service into action.

episodes.title: Fathoms
episodes.summary: With assassins hot on their trail, Peter and Rose split up en route to the White House. A shocking discovery quickly puts their lives in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Best Served Cold
episodes.summary: Now in hiding, Peter and Rose grow closer and investigate a potential bombing suspect. At the White House, the conspirators obtain a disturbing tape.

episodes.title: Redux
episodes.summary: More truths emerge about the bombing suspect's identity. Chelsea and Peter race to find Maddie after she sends a video with a coded message.

episodes.title: The Devil We Know
episodes.summary: After new revelations surface, Peter and Rose scramble to find more evidence with help from Chelsea and Maddie. A bigger threat looms at Camp David.

episodes.title: Fathers
episodes.summary: With lives at stake, the group tries to stop a nefarious plot before it's too late. In the aftermath, Peter confronts the past and begins a new chapter.

episodes.title: Call Tracking
episodes.summary: After a disastrous mission in Bangkok, Peter goes AWOL to track an American agent accused of leaking secrets. Meanwhile, Rose receives a disturbing call.

episodes.title: Disconnected
episodes.summary: Reunited at last, Peter and Rose race to intercept Warren. Noor weighs using her access to classified Iranian intelligence for her own gain.

episodes.title: Government Property
episodes.summary: Catherine aids Peter's off-the-books investigation into Foxglove while Noor stumbles upon an unexpected encounter. A hijacking spirals out of control.

episodes.title: Desperate Measures
episodes.summary: Peter and Rose infiltrate a party at the Iranian ambassador's home, arousing Javad's suspicion. Tomás and Markus lock horns over the Foxglove plan.

episodes.title: A Family Matter
episodes.summary: Eager for intel about Night Action, Jacob makes Solomon a lucrative offer. Javad senses a traitor in his midst. Sami undertakes a covert mission in Iran.

episodes.title: A Good Agent
episodes.summary: Rose grapples with a crisis of conscience. Viktor reveals his true goal to Tomás, and the hunter becomes the hunted when Solomon's team stalks Peter.

episodes.title: Tilt
episodes.summary: Peter plays hardball to force Solomon to talk. Following a lead, Rose seeks answers from a Foxglove scientist — but finds herself in a lethal situation.

episodes.title: Divergence
episodes.summary: Desperate to locate Rose, Peter makes a game-changing deal with Jacob. Tomás discovers just how far Markus is willing to go in service to his father.

episodes.title: Cultural Exchange
episodes.summary: Breaching one of the most high-security locations in New York puts Peter's skills to the test. Rose and Dr. Cole enact a daring plan to stop Markus.

episodes.title: Buyer's Remorse
episodes.summary: With time running out, Peter and Rose scramble to prevent a mass casualty event. Catherine floats an intriguing proposal.

episodes.title: Call Waiting
episodes.summary: A deadly attack ignites a crisis within the White House. In Istanbul, Peter pursues a fugitive who's stolen classified files.

episodes.title: Package Deal
episodes.summary: Peter considers a deal with the devil. Isabel follows a suspicious document trail down the rabbit hole. Night Action gets a harsh lesson in compliance.

episodes.title: Dark Matters
episodes.summary: Peter brings POTUS up to speed after a sting operation. A lethal cat-and-mouse game unfolds at the home of a reluctant source.

episodes.title: Orion
episodes.summary: Peter's visit to an exclusive hunting lodge turns into a fight for survival. Chelsea's concerns grow when a White House statement doesn't add up.

episodes.title: The Isolation Play
episodes.summary: Every second counts as Peter and Adam infiltrate a casino on a high-stakes mission. Jay finds clues to the next strike hidden in a crypto wallet.

episodes.title: Murky Waters
episodes.summary: Chelsea's off-the-books probe worries her closest ally. Peter and Isabel's rescue plan spirals out of control when the Father joins the fray.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time...
episodes.summary: An American legal consultant in Mexico finds himself caught in an impossible bind. Years later, he's trapped once again — and Peter is his only hope.

episodes.title: Truth Be Told
episodes.summary: An enigmatic opponent pushes Peter to his limits in a ruthless mind game. Jacob uses his vast database of secrets as a bargaining chip.

episodes.title: Lockstep
episodes.summary: With his Cabinet urging swift retaliation, POTUS weighs his options. Isabel and Jay scramble to crack Jacob's code. Peter's day takes an explosive turn.

episodes.title: Razzmatazz
episodes.summary: On their own, on the run and out of time, Peter and Isabel put their lives on the line to expose the conspiracy — before it silences them for good.
